newsitem.title: USA: Fortress to buy Woodside for $126.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Fortress to buy Woodside for $126.5 mln.

text.p: The Fortress Group said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the stock of and related interests in Woodside Homes Corp, first announced on Nov 7.

The purchase price of $126.5 million consists of $67.5 million in cash, $2.5 million in notes, $2.5 million in options for Fortress Group common stock (250,000 shares valued at $10.00 per share) and $54.0 million in assumed debt.oration.
The company said it intends to finance the cash portion of the transaction through the issuance of $25.0 million in convertible preferred stock and up to $42.5 million in newly issued senior notes.
Completion of the transaction is subject to final completion of due diligence, obtaining the necessary financing, and customary closing conditions, said The Fortress Group.

Woodside's president and chief operating officer Chip Nelson, and chief financial officer Len Arave, will sign three-year employment agreements with the Fortress Group and will continue in their present positions.
